profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Eric is a graduate of Fayetteville State University with a Bachelor’s of Computer Science. He has one year of  experience as an Oracle Developer at Credit Suisse, eight months of experience as an IT Consultant at FDM and two years of experience as a Software Developer at Sevatec.  Eric is a driven, detail-oriented individual who is always learning and overcoming obstacles. He has worked on the front-end and back-end of development and is proficient with database development. Eric’s accomplishments credit his ability to adapt to fast paced environments and his outstanding comprehension and retention.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Received training to become Java developer for clients of FDM. The training includes the following subjects:

1. Professional Skills
2. Unix
3. Unix scripting, SQL part 1
4. SQL part 2
5. Java Core Fundamentals and Key Tools (Eclipse, SVN)
6. JUnit, TDD, UML, and Object Oriented Principles
7. Java Core Fundamentals and Key Tools (log4j, Mockito, Maven)
8. Java Core (I/O)
9. Java Core (Multithreading)
10. Data Access using JDBC, JPA)
11. Finance
12. Web Development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML)
13. Java Web Applications on Tomcat (Servlets and JSP)
14. Spring Framework (Core)
15. Spring Framework (AOP and Web MVC)
16. Group Project (Scrum)
17. Sign Off Exams

positions.title: Oracle Developer
positions.description:
Held the role of Application Developer for an application used by the bank known as “Framesoft”. 
•	Strong knowledge of SDLC
•	Maintain a working relationship with teammates/clients in different countries
•	Created Adhoc Reports using PL/SQL queries for Clients as a part of day-to-day operations and releases
•	Developed and modified scripts using PL/SQL, UNIX, and Groovy as a part of the periodic releases
•	Ran and maintained feeds using UNIX for downstream systems and testing
•	Maintain and updated documents for Framesoft application and for the members
•	Provided IT support for Test and Production environment
•	Provided training sessions for teammates

positions.title: Undergraduate Student
positions.description:
•	Tested code/programs and debugged programs to complete in-class projects
•	Rewrote script to fulfill the requirement
•	Improved existing script to optimize performance
•	Developed and maintained system “ghosting”/imaging for fielded PC/laptop systems 
•	Performed “on call” assignments by responding to problem situations, following procedures for problem resolution and reporting, and engaging in follow-up analysis to determine and eliminate causes of errors
•	Enhanced inter-functional communications by establishing and maintaining a strong working relationship between students     and faculty
•	Tutored students and effectively communicated study strategies to ensure their academic success

volunteerExperiences.description: It really opened my eyes to the problems and struggles of families who do not have enough food to eat. It showed me that there are organization who helps people in need.
